regression.claim: All eleven previous input, outcome, decision and canonical identities reproduce. Nine returned canonical CSVs remain byte-identical; two abstentions remain explicit. The two historical failures are preserved.

limitations: One deterministic controlled signal family; not an independent patient estimate.
Waveform error is conditional on returned outputs. Abstentions are not fidelity passes.

selection.decision: Retain current selection. Small exposed development/comparison groups do not justify promotion; exhaustive-only candidates remain quarantined.
limitations: Production and exhaustive profiles are separately executed; benchmark selection is not relabelled production.
Per-candidate RSS includes its child processes and shared pages; it excludes parent/shared preprocessing and is sampled every 0.5 seconds.
Standalone candidate identity maps are unavailable; their conditional waveform error never establishes quantitative eligibility.
These exposed development inputs cannot justify a selector promotion.
Oracle uses truth offline with fixed placement and coverage constraints; unavailable candidate identity remains unavailable.
Fallback availability and QA triggers do not inspect truth. These counterfactual pairs share benchmark preprocessing/cache and cannot predict standalone wall time.
Sampled candidate subprocess RSS measures its own extra process footprint; it is not a subtraction of shared caches or the parent process.
Previously exposed development recordings; not a final cohort.
PMcardio cut-out lead truth excludes rhythm rows; no adjudicated clinical endpoint annotations.
Eight recording groups give coarse development evidence, not patient-population performance or model-training independence.
Bootstrap intervals resample 8 independent groups; small stratum counts do not support narrow precision claims.
Group bootstrap intervals can degenerate at zero or complete yield; Wilson intervals are also reported when there is exactly one attempt per group.
Engineering qualification requires fixed semantic and numeric gates; it is not clinical validation.
All attempted outcomes remain in yield; fidelity is conditional on returned and scored outputs.

interpretation: Both languages return identical waveforms, missingness, uncertainty statuses/spreads and terminal review outcome on each of the three inputs per device.

One low-resolution CPU candidate count differs: the JavaScript geometry candidate failed at 180.94 seconds, consistent with its configured 180-second deadline, while the Python repeat completed at 166.17 seconds. The retained generic failure message does not independently name a timeout.

Low-resolution CPU selects another constrained candidate: RMSE 30.199 versus 26.383 microvolts on MPS, and mean correlation 0.966257 versus 0.975562. The 0.009305 correlation loss exceeds the fixed 0.005 margin. Both remain needs_review/reviewable_constrained.
CPU low-resolution Python peak sampled process-tree RSS is 9.193 GiB, above the 9 GiB investigation budget. This is not an OS memory cap or an OOM event.
These observed limitations prevent a claim of full numerical/platform equivalence. They are preserved as failed predeclared comparisons, not removed or relabelled.

budgets.note: Use the already tested ten-minute call deadline and the existing matrix investigation limits. Report any exceeded budget or timeout without dropping the patient or repeating the final case.

limitations: RSS includes shared pages in each process; values are sampled, not an operating-system hard maximum.
Workspace size excludes the separately installed runtime and package.
One sequential heavy evaluation was launched; resource sampling is not an OS enforcement mechanism.
The protocol uses a ten-minute per-call extraction deadline, not a new production timeout.
Sampled workspace usage excludes package/runtime, frozen source archives and unrelated retained experiments.
Timeouts and abstentions remain in the all-patient denominator. No final patient was repeated to improve timing or quality.
Original, diagnostic and paper images were inspected at the displayed resolution; fine feature measurements require CSV and source evidence.
This is a qualitative agent audit, not blinded human adjudication or a clinical acceptance event.
Visual concerns neither retune the implementation nor change predeclared numerical/semantic qualification.
A no-gross-mismatch observation is not proof of accurate amplitude, intervals or narrow morphology.

boundaries: No universal clinical accuracy, independent photo/scan validation, or full platform equivalence is established.
The final set was accessed once after development, with unchanged membership, truth bytes and numerical gates; it is now exposed and must not be reused as an unseen tuning-independent set.
Older capture, selection, cold/warm and neural cancellation experiments use their separately recorded pre-gain/grid payload.
Alternative decoder, local warp, verifier-veto, model cache and persistent worker were not promoted.
Failed attempts and gates remain in the retained evidence; package/source build checks are not release approval.
No source images, patient membership or model weights are copied into this compact public receipt.
